threshold_info.bound_definition: Track A Conformal Risk Control: E[L(lambda)] <= 0.2

theoretical_semantics.Track_A: Finite-sample population expectation bound E[L(lambda_hat)] <= alpha on normalized loss L = FD / N.
theoretical_semantics.Track_B: False Discovery Rate control E[FDR] <= alpha under Benjamini-Hochberg (PRDS) or Benjamini-Yekutieli (arbitrary dependence).
theoretical_semantics.Critical_Distinction: Neither track guarantees per-scene FDP <= alpha. Empirical FDP on a single scene is an uncertified sample statistic.

evaluation.disclaimer: Sample statistic on held-out test scene; not a per-scene certification guarantee.
